description: REQ-005/006/007 (behavioral-spec.md:61-69) say 'WHEN run.sh receives a `published`/`unverified`/`failed` result' but neither behavioral-spec.md nor verification-architecture.md defines the JSON field/key name that carries this 3-way outcome string across the process boundary from post_reel.py to run.sh. The CURRENT, real integration point (run.sh:88-91) parses ONLY `d.get("post_url")` from post_reel.py's stdout JSON, and post_reel.py (post_reel.py:87, 182-183) emits `reached`/`published`(bool)/`post_url`/`error` — there is no `outcome` key anywhere in the current schema, and no such key is introduced by the spec. Without naming the wire-format field (e.g. `outcome: "published"|"unverified"|"failed"`) that run.sh must branch on, REQ-005/006/007's 3-way branching is not implementable unambiguously — the implementer must invent a schema, which is exactly the kind of judgment call an EARS spec at this fidelity should have already resolved.

evidence.snippet: WHEN run.sh receives a `published` result ... WHEN run.sh receives an `unverified` result ... WHEN run.sh receives a `failed` result
